source_title: MEK inhibitors for neurofibromatosis type 1 manifestations: Clinical evidence and consensus
claim_text: In an early report of a selumetinib trial for cutaneous neurofibromas (NCT02839720), all 6 evaluable participants showed at least a 20% decrease in average cutaneous neurofibroma volume, but systemic toxicities including rash, hypertension and skin infection limited treatment duration.
notes: Full text (PMC9629420, HTML). Statement made by the de Blank 2022 review citing Cannon 2019 (ref 60; conference presentation, no PMID). Secondary citation: the claim is not independent of the cited primary study; read the primary paper for strength grading. n=6, conference presentation only.
independence_flags: secondary citation via review PMID 35788692 of Cannon 2019 (ref 60; conference presentation, no PMID)
